config.label: Fresh Jots API token
config.description: Fresh Jots API token. Create one at https://freshjots.com/settings/api_tokens (Dev or Team plan).

config.label: Optional passphrase for transparent client-side encryption
config.description: Optional passphrase for transparent client-side encryption. When set, create_note/append_to_note accept encrypt:true and read_note accepts decrypt:true — Fresh Jots then stores only ciphertext it cannot read.
